mappings.notes: Exact method/path suppressions cover the complete surviving original legacy selector in both profiles. Existing v1.0 parity data already covers nine of ten surviving operations; shared curated entries also enforce beta and no-collision-data generation. Collection GET ListActivity operations do not match the original selector and remain available. Profile-local directives and global readmes are explicitly ignored; parameter/schema directives are deferred (none occur in this shared file). FilesDirectiveMigrationTests pins all mapped suppressions and neighboring routes.
